name: StreamingBench
intro: StreamingBench 是面向多模态大模型流式视频理解的综合基准，包含900段YouTube视频和4500组带时间戳问答，覆盖实时视觉、视听全源和上下文理解三大类18项任务。
build_method: 公开视频筛选, GPT-4o辅助生成, 人工标注与复核
eval_feature: 带时间戳视频前缀, 视听联合理解, 顺序问答历史, 主动输出
build_method_en: Public-video curation, GPT-4o-assisted generation, human annotation and review
eval_feature_en: Timestamped video prefixes, Audio-visual understanding, Sequential QA history, Proactive output
intro_en: StreamingBench is a comprehensive streaming-video-understanding benchmark for multimodal LLMs, with 900 YouTube videos and 4,500 timestamped QA pairs across 18 tasks in real-time visual, omni-source, and contextual understanding.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with StreamingBench arXiv:2411.03628 Sections 3-4 and Appendix A; official THUNLP-MT/StreamingBench repository. StreamingBench defines 18 streaming-video tasks in three categories: ten real-time visual tasks, four omni-source audio-visual tasks, and four contextual tasks. The authors manually curate 900 YouTube videos across eight scenario categories. For real-time tasks and proactive output, frames are sampled at 1 fps, timestamps are overlaid, GPT-4o captions every 20 frames, and GPT-4o generates timestamped QA; humans annotate omni-source and the other contextual tasks. Reviewers check accuracy, clarity, and relevance, revise ambiguous or mislabeled items, discard questions answerable without video, and shuffle options. The paper reports 4,500 QA pairs; 250 proactive-output questions were built, while 50 were used in the reported version. Except for proactive output, models receive only the video prefix ending at the question timestamp; sequential QA also receives prior QA history. Multiple-choice accuracy is reported. Proactive output polls once per second, requests the keyword after a yes response, and counts answers within two seconds of the reference timestamp.
